balaenoptera-musculus.body: Elongated grey-blue neutral body, small posterior fin and narrow pectorals preserved. Source caudal bend/rig crease remains.
balaenoptera-musculus.mouth: Upper rostrum and lower jaw separate; paired selected display racks follow upper mouth. Palate/rear lining are smooth simple exteriors; no tongue inversion, larynx or measured baleen fringe.
balaenoptera-musculus.pouch: Retained grey-blue outer skin expands into anterior trunk instead of an exposed pink wedge. Closed pouch remains distended, then contracts. Mottling and pleat relief stretch numerically; not calibrated material strain.
balaenoptera-musculus.motion: Selected staged advance slows after opening; tail holds near top of selected beat during gape and recovers. No solved thrust/flow/retention.
balaenoptera-musculus.review: 29nonblank compiled states including axes, approach/open/max/closing/closed/drain/hold, original swim, Observe reset, mouth/pouch/fin details individually inspected.

megaptera-novaeangliae.body: Retained dark/white atlas, long pectorals and tuberculated rostrum remain distinct from blue whale. Source facial/nodule anatomy remains coarse.
megaptera-novaeangliae.mouth: Cranial elevation prominent, lower jaw depresses; visible inner lining and paired racks. Oral roof/lining stay flat and pigment numerical; incomplete tongue/pharynx and lip/cheek transitions remain.
megaptera-novaeangliae.pouch: A rounded retained pleated lower exterior joins anterior trunk continuously after rejection of abrupt posterior puffing. Expansion/closure/contraction visible; pleats/white pigment stretch rather than represent measured tissue optics.
megaptera-novaeangliae.motion: A longer selected contraction period follows closure. Pectoral contribution, bubble-netting, prey transport, flow and energetic/respiratory regulation remain unfinished. Static rest pose is not sleep.
megaptera-novaeangliae.review: 31nonblank compiled states individually inspected, including three-axis neutral/forage/swim/rest and mouth/pouch foci.

beforeTargetRecords.summary: A large rorqual with a broad, relatively flat rostrum, mottled grey-blue skin, small posterior dorsal fin and horizontal flukes. Individual proportions and markings vary. The species-level accession does not identify the creator model to subspecies, sex, age or population.

anatomy.name: Broad rostrum and paired blowholes
anatomy.description: A broad, flatter selected dorsal rostrum with a median ridge and paired blowhole region. Head, eye and blowhole rims remain simplified; this is not an independently determined individual or subspecies.

anatomy.name: Horizontal flukes and caudal peduncle
anatomy.description: The retained horizontal flukes and tapering posterior body articulate dorsoventrally through the creator skeleton. Excursions, tissue strain and hydrodynamic performance have not been measured or fitted.

anatomy.name: Pectoral flippers and ventral pleats
anatomy.description: A more compact pectoral outline and grey-blue ventral surface replace the earlier broad flipper/white-field appearance. Ventral pleats remain mainly atlas/normal relief; no measured pleat count, pouch mechanics, calibrated pigment or feeding reconstruction.

anatomy.name: Small posterior dorsal fin
anatomy.description: A low selected dorsal-fin exterior is retained near the posterior quarter of the body. Its smooth joined root follows the same skin. The reduced outline and relative height are authored choices, not a fit to a measured individual or universal fin dimensions.

behaviors.label: Fluke and flipper study
behaviors.description: The same corrected textured surface and retained creator skeleton play a finite fluke/flipper excerpt at half the source speed, then hold. Playback seconds, joint excursions and phasing are unmeasured. It does not model a swimming trajectory, fluid thrust, energetic cost, feeding or respiration. Observe holds the first creator frame, avoiding a discontinuous switch from the raw bind pose.
behaviors.evidence: Species-specific qualitative locomotion context and retained creator excerpt; no fitted trajectories
behaviors.timeScale: uncalibrated display seconds; half source speed; finite 8.167-second excerpt

rendering.reason: Same credited corrected surface and skeleton; no fitted real-animal kinematics, full trajectory or hydrodynamics.

behaviors.label: Lunge feeding mechanism
behaviors.description: Krill engulfment uses opening jaws, an extensible ventral pouch and subsequent filtration through baleen. This interaction is not reconstructed.
behaviors.evidence: Documented species behaviour; no complete prey/pouch/filtration mechanism in the viewer

rendering.reason: Prey, oral cavity, pouch expansion and filtration are incomplete; the fluke excerpt is not labelled as feeding.

visual.fidelity: Credited textured artist interpretation with disclosed exterior and atlas derivatives; unmeasured
visual.description: v0.6.48: Selected elongated/slender scene aspect (longitudinal 1.22, depth 0.80) applied to body and rig together; lower dorsal-fin exterior carried farther aft on a smooth monotone joined posterior rest-surface, flatter rostrum and more compact pectoral envelope. Two posed-space subdivision passes with inverse-skin rebinding retain continuous skin and interpolated UV/weights. A reproducible 2.2-pixel smoothed atlas with a 24-pixel broad field separates bounded local luminance detail from the earlier abrupt navy/white scheme, recolouring the whole surface grey-blue. This is authored pigment, not photographic sampling or calibrated optics. Original binary prefix, nodes/skins/accessors and animation samples are retained; two other active images unchanged. Regional rest-surface/rig relations remain unmeasured; the original clip is not fitted biomechanics. Legacy0.6.47delivery remains exactly reproducible using legacy-v0647.
visual.scale: Normalized display, not a specimen measurement

viewerRig.type: Retained 24-joint creator skeleton; finite source excerpt
viewerRig.description: Retained source skeleton and finite 8.167-second half-speed appendage study on one elongated grey-blue surface. No full swimming, feeding, respiration or fluid/force model.

review.status: Qualitative body, fin and colour correction; 27 actual compiled views inspected, no independent biological validation
remaining: Proportions, fin dimensions and grey-blue colour mapping are authored qualitative choices, not measurements or a specimen fit.

Skin mottling remains a locally normalized and recoloured artist atlas. Natural individual variation, underwater scattering, scars, epibionts, wet specular response and deep tissue optics are not reconstructed.
Source animation is a finite local fluke/flipper excerpt, not measured full swimming, respiration, feeding, flow, contact force, energetics or physiology.
Mouth/baleen, ventral pouch/pleat depth, paired blowhole rims and eye anatomy remain simplified.
Final software compatibility views cannot establish working WebGL material/normal-map optics.
The caudal/back slope and local rig-bend crease, frontal cross-section, fluke thickness and fin profile remain selected artist geometry rather than fitted living soft tissue.

identityAuthority.provider: MDD v2.5 and WoRMS accepted species

taxonomy.nameDecision: One species-level Balaenoptera musculus concept agreed by MDD v2.5 row1006401, accepted WoRMS137090 and GBIF2440735. No separate subspecies accession; artist and NOAA photo are not determined to the same individual or subspecies. MDD order Artiodactyla and GBIF Cetacea reflect different higher-rank treatments.
